body:
I think your ideas are excellent, and I've been considering similar scenarios and directions myself. I'm not sure whether you've used DeepSeek Harness — it has something like a timeline feature. We could do timeline-style diagrams too, where each point on the timeline is a snapshot: the state of what we've drawn at that particular moment. I think that would be really valuable.
Thank you so much for your input. Going forward, I'm also planning to build out plugin support, so that all kinds of scenario extensions from community users can flourish — I believe that's enormously valuable.
I don't know whether you'd be interested in being part of this, but you'd be very welcome. Thank you again for the suggestion.

I'd like to take the initial use-case and design-evidence slice for this issue.

I'll revisit the reading problem on current dev, since the Viewer has changed since the original report, and compare a small sequential/parallel example using existing Architecture labels and a Sequence alternative while preserving the same authored relationships. I'll document static export, Still and reduced-motion behavior, then propose the smallest useful contract for discussion, including whether existing authoring capabilities already suffice.

This is an investigation claim, not an assumption that the proposed order syntax or animation contract has been approved. I won't start a new schema or animation implementation before that scope is agreed. The work will be AI-assisted, with the tested revision and limits of the evidence disclosed.
